newsitem.title: USA: RTRS - James Hardie sells Irrigation unit for US$130 million.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - James Hardie sells Irrigation unit for US$130 million.

text.p: Toro Co said Thursday it has agreed to buy the James Hardie Irrigation Group from Australia-based James Hardie Industries Ltd for about $130 million.
The purchase is expected to have a modest dilutive effect on earnings per share during the first year, Toro said.

"Toro believes this acquisition will strengthen our ability to grow in this market, providing added value for our shareholders," Toro chairman and chief executive officer Kendrick Melrose said in a news release.
James Hardie Irrigation is based in Laguna Niguel, California and has production facilities in Texas, California, Florida and Australia, Toro said.
The company has about 1,100 full-time and temporary employees, Toro said.
